fullPassage: A viewfinder is a piece of card with a hole cut through it in the middle, which can be used to isolate a part of a picture or object. It allows us to concentrate on one small part or area without being distracted by the whole of what can be seen. It is a useful tool that can help children focus or organise their observation and drawing. It can support hesitant children by giving a boundary to what they are looking at and it can support children who find it hard to keep track of where and what they are looking at, by bringing them back to the same area each time they look and look back. When you are making viewfinders for use with the children you are supporting, take into consideration the size of the card. You need enough card around the hole to block out the rest of the visual information from the child's field of vision, but it should not be too big and unwieldy.

It allows us to concentrate on one small part or area without being distracted by the whole of what can be seen. It is a useful tool that can help children focus or organise their observation and drawing. It can support hesitant children by giving a boundary to what they are looking at and it can support children who find it hard to keep track of where and what they are looking at, by <u>bringing them back to the same area each time they look and look back</u>. When you are making viewfinders for use with the children you are supporting, take into consideration the size of the card. You need enough card around the hole to block out the rest of the visual information from the child's field of vision, but it should not be too big and unwieldy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 bringing them back to the same area each time they look and look back이 함축하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '볼 때마다 같은 영역으로 되돌려준다'는 것은 시선이 분산되지 않도록 반복적으로 같은 지점에 집중시켜 관찰의 일관성을 유지한다는 의미.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 새로운 대상 탐색 격려 — 원문 반대(같은 영역 반복)

✅ ② 반복적 시선 고정 + 관찰 일관성 — 'same area each time' 함축 ←정답

❌ ③ 처음부터 다시 그리기 유도 — 그리기가 아닌 관찰 시선의 문제

❌ ④ 관찰 대상 자주 변경 — 원문 반대(same area)
det.tip: bringing back to the same area = 시선 분산 방지 → 관찰 일관성 확보

ch: 아이들이 새로운 관찰 대상을 끊임없이 탐색하도록 격려한다.
반복적으로 같은 지점에 시선을 고정시켜 관찰의 일관성을 유지해 준다.
아이들이 그림을 완성한 후 처음부터 다시 그리도록 유도한다.
관찰 대상을 자주 바꾸어 다양한 시각적 경험을 제공한다.
